cd /root/.claude/projects/-app/8c9140a4-5c91-44a7-9b82-5e29ff673aaf/tool-results/
python3 -c "
import json,re
d=json.load(open('mcp-mcp_91fcc24c-list_issues-1785013358499.txt'))
issues=json.loads(d['result'])['issues']
kw=re.compile(r'cluster|HVAC|plumb|electric|panel|coil|filter|QC|spot-check|preventive|water heater|hose bib|condensate|disposal|compressor',re.I)
for i in issues:
    text=(i['title']+' '+(i.get('description') or ''))
    if kw.search(text):
        print('====',i['identifier'],'| proj:',(i.get('project') or {}).get('id'),'|',i['state']['name'],'| assignee:',(i.get('assignee') or {}).get('name'))
        print('TITLE:',i['title'])
        print('DESC:',(i.get('description') or '').strip())
        print('created:',i['createdAt'],'completedAt:',i.get('completedAt'))
        print()
"

There is no record those two units were repaired or re-inspected before I logged the cluster as "clean/Done" on 5/25. That result cannot stand, so I've reopened it (OPS-98) and withdrawn the sign-off.
- Who's holding it: John Smith (maintenance execution), Tony Reyes (North HVAC lead) for the repairs; me for the re-inspection.
- To close: crew back onsite to complete the coil/panel/plumbing work on both units (logged as maintenance ticket MT-2026-1330), then I re-inspect and confirm. I have that re-inspection booked for 7/6.

SOUTH CLUSTER — clears
- HVAC spot-check stands as a pass (airflow, coils, refrigerant all clean on the 5/25 sample). Electrical panel inspections are complete and documented (Patricia Nguyen) — I moved OPS-186 to Done so the record matches reality.
- To close: nothing outstanding on my side for South.

WEST CLUSTER — still in progress
- What's open: the full HVAC/plumbing/electrical scope is still underway; this is the one cluster not wrapped (OPS-35).
- Who's holding it: Lisa Smith (onsite lead), John Smith (execution).
- To close: West work completed and confirmed, then QC.

PLUMBING (portfolio) — open
- What's open: two water heaters flagged for replacement plus a handful of hose bibs needing repair (Carlos, 5/31; you flagged the water heaters as a budget priority on 6/3).
- Who's holding it: Carlos Mendez. I raised it as its own tracking item (OPS-1000).
- To close: replacements/repairs scheduled and completed, with any owner-billable pass-through paperwork started.

HVAC FILTER SWEEP (portfolio) — not confirmed complete
- What's open: the sweep can't be called done — 20x25 filter stock ran out mid-run (John, 5/23) and West is still open. My filter QC (OPS-96) was logged "all clean" prematurely and is back open.
- Who's holding it: John Smith, with Elias Navarro and Tony Reyes (OPS-79; note OPS-51 and OPS-71 are duplicate filter issues to consolidate).
- To close: filter replacements confirmed complete across all clusters, then I re-run the filter QC.

FIELD FOLLOW-UPS (in the maintenance log, needing a tech back onsite)
- MT-2026-1330 — North: two units, coil/plumbing/panel (John/Tony)
- MT-2026-1331 — two units with recurring condensate drain clogs + one compressor to watch (Elias)
I'll re-inspect both on 7/6 once the crew has been back out.

Net: South passes; North does not and the sign-off is withdrawn; West, plumbing, and the filter sweep are still open. I don't think this should be treated as closeable until the North re-work + re-inspection, West completion, the plumbing items, and the filter sweep are done. Happy to walk through any of it.

Thanks,
Jaime
